result.rationale: The diff adds addMembers in the controller calling this.get("model").addMembers(usernames), and Group.addMembers returns Discourse.ajax(...).then(...) with no catch; the controller neither handles rejection nor disables/re-enables save. The backend can return 422 (can_not_modify_automatic) or render_json_error, so a failure yields an unhandled rejection with no user feedback and stale member list. The mechanism is visible in the diff, though severity is modest since the add UI is hidden for automatic groups.
